reason: I'd pin it to the board, but I wouldn't spend $360 on a light from a store I've never heard of. The page doesn't give me what my electrician needs, like lumens, UL listing, or install details, so I can't spec it.
objection: $360 is a lot for an unknown brand, and I have no UL listing, lumen output, or install specs to give my electrician. Paying return shipping on a 23.6 inch fixture if it looks wrong in the room is a real risk, and so are 6 weeks for made-to-order.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with lumens, CRI, UL/ETL listing, dimensions, canopy and wiring details, plus real customer photos or reviews of the piece installed, and free returns or a sample.
